title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): In Copilot Pages, the Chat can now be used to modify the Page
description: When a Chat and a Page are open side by side, prompts within the Chat can now be used to modify or add to the contents of the Page.
descriptionHtml: When a Chat and a Page are open side by side, prompts within the Chat can now be used to modify or add to the contents of the Page.
